chinese: 相信直觉但用事实来验证
english: trust their gut but verify with facts
soundmark: /trʌst ðeər ɡʌt bʌt ˈverɪfaɪ wɪð fækts/

chinese: 当涉及做重要决定时许多人依赖他们的直觉
english: When it comes to making important decisions many people rely on their intuition
soundmark: /wen ɪt kʌmz tuː ˈmeɪkɪŋ ɪmˈpɔːrtənt dɪˈsɪʒənz ˈmeni ˈpiːpəl rɪˈlaɪ ɒn ðeər ˌɪntjuˈɪʃən/

chinese: 虽然直觉可能有用但它常常受到个人偏见的影响
english: While intuition can be useful it's often influenced by personal biases
soundmark: /waɪl ˌɪntjuˈɪʃən kæn biː ˈjuːsfəl ɪts ˈɒfən ˈɪnfluənst baɪ ˈpɜːrsənəl ˈbaɪəsɪz/

chinese: 最好是收集信息并仔细考虑所有可能性
english: It's better to gather information and consider all possibilities carefully
soundmark: /ɪts ˈbetər tuː ˈɡæðər ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən ænd kənˈsɪdər ɔːl ˌpɒsɪˈbɪlɪtiz ˈkeərfəli/

chinese: 花时间思考可以防止我们做出以后会后悔的选择
english: Taking time to think prevents us from making choices we might later regret
soundmark: /ˈteɪkɪŋ taɪm tuː θɪŋk prɪˈvents ʌs frɒm ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈtʃɔɪsɪz wiː maɪt ˈleɪtər rɪˈɡret/

chinese: 换句话说仔细思考比快速感觉更可靠
english: In other words careful thinking is more reliable than quick feelings
soundmark: /ɪn ˈʌðər wɜːrdz ˈkeərfəl ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ɪz mɔːr rɪˈlaɪəbəl ðæn kwɪk ˈfiːlɪŋz/

chinese: 成功的决策者将直觉与分析相结合
english: Successful decision makers balance intuition with analysis
soundmark: /səkˈsesfəl dɪˈsɪʒən ˈmeɪkərz ˈbæləns ˌɪntjuˈɪʃən wɪð əˈnæləsɪs/
